Case: Nga is a 77-year-old with history of lung cancer who presents with 3 months of diffuse back pain and progressive, unintentional weight loss. Nga describes the pain as constant and exacerbated by bending and twisting movements of her spine. In addition to increasing pain, she endorses progressive diffuse weakness, and she now to requires a front-wheel-walker to ambulate. Upon examining Nga, you find that she is cachetic and diffusely deconditioned. You palpate the full length of her spine and note that she is diffusely tender.
